stem: An inclined plane is bent in such a way that the vertical cross-section is given by $y = \frac{x^{2}}{4}$ where y is in vertical and x in horizontal direction. If the upper surface of this curved plane is rough with coefficient of friction μ = 0.5, the maximum height in cm at which a stationary block will not slip downwards is ….. cm.

assets.alt: A parabola y against x through the origin, with a dashed tangent of slope μ at the highest point where an object can stay; label: limit tan θ = dy/dx = x/2 = μ.
